subject: CareKin renewal: on‑prem analytics cluster + staged migration (term & pricing ask)
messages:

To: alex.martinez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning: on-prem analytics cluster + migration window

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. As we discussed on the call, CareKin is preparing to expand our private footprint during renewal: we need an isolated analytics cluster in our on‑prem VPC to run PHI‑adjacent reporting and reduce cross‑tenant blast radius. High level asks: 

- Two additional clusters (analytics + staging) behind the existing private control plane, VPC peering to our BI network
- A staged migration plan (weekend cutover preferred) with clear rollback steps
- KMS/HSM keying model and evidence for our auditors (SOC2 + HIPAA readiness)
- Pricing for committed capacity and burst pool for quarterly spikes

I attached a short requirements workbook with traffic profiles and a sample retention policy. Can you confirm what a realistic timeline and cost look like, plus any term-commit tradeoffs you typically offer? Procurement is watching this closely (procurement@carekin.com).

We’d like to lock an update to the commercial term at renewal to cover the new capacity (targeting an 18‑month extension with staged billing). Happy to hop on a call — I’m PDT mornings next week.

Best,
Danielle
Director, Platform Ops | CareKin

Attachments: CareKin_expansion_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

1) Week of May 3 — technical kickoff and network checklist
2) Week of May 17 — provision clusters in staging and run validation tests
3) Weekend of Jun 12 — phased cutover (low‑traffic weekend) with rollback window

I attached the requirement workbook to my notes and looped Karthik and Marissa for the two workstreams. If that timeline looks tight we can push the cutover to late June.

—Alex

Hi Danielle / Alex — I reviewed the workbook and sketched an operational plan. High-level technical notes: 

- Fleet profile: two clusters (analytics: 24 vGPUs aggregate; staging: 8 vGPUs) — recommend NVIDIA A40/A100 equivalent nodes to match inference batch workloads.
- Network/Isolation: separate VPC peering and route tables; we’ll enforce egress restrictions and set up a dedicated control-plane role that can’t access tenant data by default.
- Migration approach: 
  * Phase 0 (prework): config sync, DR playbook, KMS test vectors (2 weeks)
  * Phase 1 (shadow): replicate production traffic to analytics cluster for 7 days
  * Phase 2 (crossover): progressively route 20%/50%/100% over a weekend with hourly checkpoints
  * Phase 3: rollback plan and post‑cutover validation (48h)
- Ops SLOs: propose a 99.5% availability target for analytics cluster during ramp. If you need higher SLOs we’ll need a reserved standby node buffer.
- Timeline: assuming approvals, provisioning and validation complete in ~5 weeks. Cutover weekend targeted in mid‑June as Alex proposed.

I attached a cost-by-node CSV estimate and a short ops checklist. Two asks from your side to speed provisioning: (1) the KMS contact and IP ranges for the BI network, (2) confirmation on whether data residency requires encrypted disk at rest via customer KMS.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: karthik_provision_estimate.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: Danielle Reed <danielle@carekin.com>, alex.martinez@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Renewal planning: on-prem analytics cluster + migration window

Danielle — looping in the commercial side. Based on Karthik’s estimate we can structure the renewal amendment as follows: 

- Term & pricing: 18‑month term extension from the current renewal date with a 12% committed capacity discount applied to the two additional clusters. Staged billing: 50% charge at provisioning, remainder billed across the term monthly.
- Burst credits: include a quarterly burst pool (75 CPU-equivalent hours / quarter) priced at a prefixed rate; unused credits don’t roll over.
- SLA & standby: include optional standby nodes (billed as reserved) if you want an elevated 99.9% target during the first 90 days.
- Security/Docs: we’ll attach the SOC2 evidence bundle and a KMS integration runbook to the DocuSign amendment.

I’ll prepare a draft amendment and DocuSign packet — if you can confirm the KMS contact and the procurement email we’ll include them as signers. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CK-2027-149.

If this commercial structure looks ok I’ll send the packet today and slot a kickoff call for May 4th.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Contract Manager, Redwood Inference
